
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/wsry/p/22363584" title="发布于 2026-08-10 14:22">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Qt 图形填充规则实战：OddEven vs Winding，顺逆时针如何影响填充与点击检测</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        在 QGraphicsView 框架下，多个形状组合为 QPainterPath 时常出现填充不完整、内部区域点击不响应的问题。本文通过调整填充规则（奇偶规则/环绕规则）与各子形状的绘制方向（顺/逆时针），使两者匹配，从而解决上述问题；对于方向固定的弧线，采用负角度绘制或 toReversed() 反向路径加以解决，并给出验证实验。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<br>
<p>摘要：<br>
    在 <code>QGraphicsView</code> 框架下，多个形状组合为 <code>QPainterPath</code> 时常出现填充不完整、内部区域点击不响应的问题。本文通过调整填充规则（奇偶规则/环绕规则）与各子形状的绘制方向（顺/逆时针），使两者匹配，从而解决上述问题；对于方向固定的弧线，采用负角度绘制或 <code>toReversed()</code> 反向路径加以解决，并给出验证实验。<br>
<br></p>
<p>关键词：<br>
    <code>QPainterPath</code>；<code>QGraphicsView</code>；填充规则；奇偶规则；环绕规则；顺逆时针；<code>WindingFill</code>；<code>OddEvenFill</code>；<code>toReversed</code>；路径方向<br>
<br></p>
<p>版本：Qt 5.14.2<br>
<br></p>
<h4 id="问题描述">问题描述：</h4>
<p>    在<code>QGraphicsView</code>框架下，组合多种形状的<code>QPainterPath</code>，</p>
<ul>
<li>在填充颜色时，没有完全填充；</li>
<li>鼠标点击某些内部区域时，没有响应鼠标事件；</li>
<li>对于某些没有闭合的曲线，上述问题同样存在。<br>
<br></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="解决思路">解决思路：</h4>
<p>    调整<code>QPainterPath</code>填充规则（<code>fillRule</code>），以及各个子形状或者路径的绘制方向（顺时针或逆时针）<br>
    Qt提供两种填充规则：奇偶规则（<code>Qt::OddEvenFill</code>）、环绕规则（<code>Qt::WindingFill</code>），默认为奇偶规则</p>
<ul>
<li>奇偶规则：使用这个规则时，我们通过以下方法判断一个点是否在形状内部：从该点画一条水平线到形状外部，然后数交点的数量。如果交点数是奇数，说明该点在形状内部。</li>
<li>环绕规则：根据这个规则，我们通过以下方法判断一个点是否在形状内部：从该点画一条水平线到形状外部的位置，确定线每个交点的方向是向上还是向下。通过将每个交点方向相加来确定环绕数。如果这个数不为零，说明该点在形状内部。在大多数情况下，这种填充模式也可以看作是闭合形状的交集。<br>
<br></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2951860/202608/2951860-20260810112532446-2125563940.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2951860/202608/2951860-20260810112604986-1542684015.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<br></p>
<h4 id="数据准备">数据准备：</h4>
<details open=""><summary>点击折叠或展开代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void Form::initGraphics()
{
    m_scene = new QGraphicsScene(this);
    ui-&gt;graphicsView-&gt;setScene(m_scene);

    // 绘制底层直线，测试填充效果
    QGraphicsLineItem *line = new QGraphicsLineItem;
    line-&gt;setLine(-1000, 50, 1000, 50);
    line-&gt;setZValue(-100);
    m_scene-&gt;addItem(line);

    QGraphicsLineItem *line2 = new QGraphicsLineItem;
    line2-&gt;setLine(-1000, 180, 1000, 180);
    line2-&gt;setZValue(-100);
    m_scene-&gt;addItem(line2);
}

QGraphicsPathItem *Form::createPathItem(const QPainterPath &amp;path, const QPointF &amp;pos, const QString &amp;label)
{
    QGraphicsPathItem *item = new QGraphicsPathItem;
    item-&gt;setPath(path);
    item-&gt;setPos(pos);
    item-&gt;setFlag(QGraphicsItem::ItemIsMovable, true);
    item-&gt;setBrush(Qt::green);
    m_scene-&gt;addItem(item);

    QGraphicsSimpleTextItem *text = new QGraphicsSimpleTextItem;
    text-&gt;setText(label);
    text-&gt;setParentItem(item);
    text-&gt;setPos(0, -20);

    return item;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p>代码说明：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>initGraphics()</code>中，创建画布<code>QGraphicsScene</code>，准备两条水平线；</li>
<li><code>createPathItem</code>方法中，创建图形，添加形状或者路径，设置位置和填充颜色，设置文字标签显示方便区分；</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="示例代码">示例代码：</h4>
<details open=""><summary>点击折叠或展开代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-C++">// 创建正方形
QPolygonF Form::makeSquarePolygon(bool clockwise)
{
    QPolygonF p;
    if (clockwise)
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100);
    else
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0);
    p &lt;&lt; p.first();
    return p;
}

// 创建三角形
QPolygonF Form::makeTrianglePolygon(bool clockwise)
{
    QPolygonF p;
    if (clockwise)
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(50, 100);
    else
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(50, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0);
    p &lt;&lt; p.first();
    return p;
}

// 分别创建顺、逆时针的正方形和三角形，横向排列
void Form::squareCwTriangleCw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(true));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item1 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(0, 0), "SqCW_TrCW");
}

void Form::squareCwTriangleCcw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(true));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item2 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(130, 0), "SqCW_TrCCW");
}

void Form::squareCcwTriangleCw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(false));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item3 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(260, 0), "SqCCW_TrCW");
}

void Form::squareCcwTriangleCcw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(false));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item4 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(390, 0), "SqCCW_TrCCW");
}

// 变换填充规则并刷新
void Form::applyFillRule(Qt::FillRule rule)
{
    QList&lt;QGraphicsPathItem *&gt; list;
    list &lt;&lt; m_item1 &lt;&lt; m_item2 &lt;&lt; m_item3 &lt;&lt; m_item4;

    for (QGraphicsPathItem *item : qAsConst(list)) {
        QPainterPath path = item-&gt;path();
        path.setFillRule(rule);
        item-&gt;setPath(path);
    }

    m_scene-&gt;update();
}

// 用两个按钮来切换填充规则
void Form::onOddEvenClicked()
{
    applyFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);
}

void Form::onWindingClicked()
{
    applyFillRule(Qt::WindingFill);
}

// 测试代码
Form::Form(QWidget *parent) :
    QWidget(parent),
    ui(new Ui::Form)
{
    ui-&gt;setupUi(this);

    // 创建画布及水平线
    initGraphics();
    // 创建顺逆时针的正方形和三角形
    squareCwTriangleCw();
    squareCwTriangleCcw();
    squareCcwTriangleCw();
    squareCcwTriangleCcw();
    // 连接按钮信号，切换填充规则
    connect(ui-&gt;pushButton_oddeven, &amp;QPushButton::clicked, this, &amp;Form::onOddEvenClicked);
    connect(ui-&gt;pushButton_winding, &amp;QPushButton::clicked, this, &amp;Form::onWindingClicked);
}

</code></pre>
</details>
<p>代码说明：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>makeSquarePolygon</code>创建正方形，<code>makeTrianglePolygon</code>创建三角形；</li>
<li><code>squareXXTriangleXX</code>方法创建顺逆时针的正方形和三角形；注意，在框架中，向下为Y轴正方向；</li>
<li><code>applyFillRule</code>修改填充规则，通过两个按钮来改变；<br>
<br></li>
</ol>

<h4 id="其他问题">其他问题：</h4>
<p>    面对其他不规则图形，绘制方向是固定的，比如Qt中的弧线，默认从3点开始逆时针绘制，如何解决？<br>
思路：</p>
<ol>
<li>使用负数角度，可以顺时针绘制；</li>
<li>使用<code>QPainterPath</code>的<code>toReversed</code>方法，逆向路径绘制；<br>
<br></li>
</ol>
<h4 id="示例代码-1">示例代码：</h4>
<details open=""><summary>点击折叠或展开代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-C++">// 创建矩形
QPolygonF Form::makeRectPolygon(bool clockwise)
{
    QPolygonF p;
    if (clockwise)
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100);
    else
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 0);
    p &lt;&lt; p.first();
    return p;
}
// 创建弧线
QPainterPath Form::makeArcPath(bool reversed)
{
    QPainterPath arc;
    arc.moveTo(200, 50);
    arc.arcTo(QRectF(0, 0, 200, 100), 0, 270);
    if (reversed)
        arc = arc.toReversed();
    return arc;
}

// 创建顺逆时针的矩形和弧线
void Form::rectCwArc()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(true));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item5 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(0, 130), "RectCW_Arc");
}

void Form::rectCwArcReverse()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(true));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item6 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(230, 130), "RectCW_ArcReverse");
}

void Form::rectCcwArc()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(false));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item7 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(460, 130), "RectCCW_Arc");
}

void Form::rectCcwArcReverse()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(false));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item8 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(690, 130), "RectCCW_ArcReverse");
}

void Form::applyFillRule(Qt::FillRule rule)
{
    QList&lt;QGraphicsPathItem *&gt; list;
    list &lt;&lt; m_item1 &lt;&lt; m_item2 &lt;&lt; m_item3 &lt;&lt; m_item4
         &lt;&lt; m_item5 &lt;&lt; m_item6 &lt;&lt; m_item7 &lt;&lt; m_item8;

    for (QGraphicsPathItem *item : qAsConst(list)) {
        QPainterPath path = item-&gt;path();
        path.setFillRule(rule);
        item-&gt;setPath(path);
    }

    m_scene-&gt;update();
}

</code></pre>
</details>
<p>代码说明：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>makeRectPolygon</code>方法创建矩形，<code>makeArcPath</code>方法创建一个四分之三圆的弧线；</li>
<li><code>rectXXXArcXXX</code>方法分别绘制顺逆时针的矩形、正反向绘制的弧线；<br>
<br></li>
</ol>

<h4 id="附录二完整代码">附录二：完整代码</h4>
<ul>
<li>form.h</li>

<details><summary>点击折叠或展开代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-C++">#ifndef FORM_H
#define FORM_H

#include &lt;QWidget&gt;
#include &lt;QtWidgets&gt;
#include &lt;QGraphicsItem&gt;

namespace Ui {
class Form;
}

class Form : public QWidget
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit Form(QWidget *parent = nullptr);
    ~Form();

private:
    Ui::Form *ui;

    QGraphicsScene *m_scene = nullptr;

    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item1 = nullptr;
    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item2 = nullptr;
    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item3 = nullptr;
    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item4 = nullptr;

    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item5 = nullptr;
    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item6 = nullptr;
    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item7 = nullptr;
    QGraphicsPathItem *m_item8 = nullptr;

    void initGraphics();

    QGraphicsPathItem *createPathItem(const QPainterPath &amp;path, const QPointF &amp;pos, const QString &amp;label);
    QPolygonF makeSquarePolygon(bool clockwise);
    QPolygonF makeRectPolygon(bool clockwise);
    QPolygonF makeTrianglePolygon(bool clockwise);
    QPainterPath makeArcPath(bool reversed);

    void squareCwTriangleCw();
    void squareCwTriangleCcw();
    void squareCcwTriangleCw();
    void squareCcwTriangleCcw();

    void rectCwArc();
    void rectCwArcReverse();
    void rectCcwArc();
    void rectCcwArcReverse();

    void applyFillRule(Qt::FillRule rule);
    void onOddEvenClicked();
    void onWindingClicked();
};

#endif // FORM_H

</code></pre>
</details>
<ul>
<li>form.cpp</li>
</ul>
<details><summary>点击折叠或展开代码</summary>
<pre><code class="language-C++">#include "form.h"
#include "ui_form.h"

Form::Form(QWidget *parent) :
    QWidget(parent),
    ui(new Ui::Form)
{
    ui-&gt;setupUi(this);

    initGraphics();

    squareCwTriangleCw();
    squareCwTriangleCcw();
    squareCcwTriangleCw();
    squareCcwTriangleCcw();

    rectCwArc();
    rectCwArcReverse();
    rectCcwArc();
    rectCcwArcReverse();

    connect(ui-&gt;pushButton_oddeven, &amp;QPushButton::clicked, this, &amp;Form::onOddEvenClicked);
    connect(ui-&gt;pushButton_winding, &amp;QPushButton::clicked, this, &amp;Form::onWindingClicked);
}

Form::~Form()
{
    delete ui;
}

void Form::initGraphics()
{
    m_scene = new QGraphicsScene(this);
    ui-&gt;graphicsView-&gt;setScene(m_scene);

    // 绘制底层直线，测试填充效果
    QGraphicsLineItem *line = new QGraphicsLineItem;
    line-&gt;setLine(-1000, 50, 1000, 50);
    line-&gt;setZValue(-100);
    m_scene-&gt;addItem(line);

    QGraphicsLineItem *line2 = new QGraphicsLineItem;
    line2-&gt;setLine(-1000, 180, 1000, 180);
    line2-&gt;setZValue(-100);
    m_scene-&gt;addItem(line2);
}

QGraphicsPathItem *Form::createPathItem(const QPainterPath &amp;path, const QPointF &amp;pos, const QString &amp;label)
{
    QGraphicsPathItem *item = new QGraphicsPathItem;
    item-&gt;setPath(path);
    item-&gt;setPos(pos);
    item-&gt;setFlag(QGraphicsItem::ItemIsMovable, true);
    item-&gt;setBrush(Qt::green);
    m_scene-&gt;addItem(item);

    QGraphicsSimpleTextItem *text = new QGraphicsSimpleTextItem;
    text-&gt;setText(label);
    text-&gt;setParentItem(item);
    text-&gt;setPos(0, -20);

    return item;
}

QPolygonF Form::makeSquarePolygon(bool clockwise)
{
    QPolygonF p;
    if (clockwise)
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100);
    else
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0);
    p &lt;&lt; p.first();
    return p;
}

QPolygonF Form::makeRectPolygon(bool clockwise)
{
    QPolygonF p;
    if (clockwise)
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100);
    else
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(200, 0);
    p &lt;&lt; p.first();
    return p;
}

QPolygonF Form::makeTrianglePolygon(bool clockwise)
{
    QPolygonF p;
    if (clockwise)
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(50, 100);
    else
        p &lt;&lt; QPointF(0, 0) &lt;&lt; QPointF(50, 100) &lt;&lt; QPointF(100, 0);
    p &lt;&lt; p.first();
    return p;
}

QPainterPath Form::makeArcPath(bool reversed)
{
    QPainterPath arc;
    arc.moveTo(200, 50);
    arc.arcTo(QRectF(0, 0, 200, 100), 0, 270);
    if (reversed)
        arc = arc.toReversed();
    return arc;
}

void Form::squareCwTriangleCw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(true));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item1 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(0, 0), "SqCW_TrCW");
}

void Form::squareCwTriangleCcw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(true));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item2 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(130, 0), "SqCW_TrCCW");
}

void Form::squareCcwTriangleCw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(false));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item3 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(260, 0), "SqCCW_TrCW");
}

void Form::squareCcwTriangleCcw()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeSquarePolygon(false));
    path.addPolygon(makeTrianglePolygon(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item4 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(390, 0), "SqCCW_TrCCW");
}

void Form::rectCwArc()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(true));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item5 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(0, 130), "RectCW_Arc");
}

void Form::rectCwArcReverse()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(true));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item6 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(230, 130), "RectCW_ArcReverse");
}

void Form::rectCcwArc()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(false));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(false));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item7 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(460, 130), "RectCCW_Arc");
}

void Form::rectCcwArcReverse()
{
    QPainterPath path;
    path.addPolygon(makeRectPolygon(false));
    path.addPath(makeArcPath(true));
    path.setFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);

    m_item8 = createPathItem(path, QPointF(690, 130), "RectCCW_ArcReverse");
}

void Form::applyFillRule(Qt::FillRule rule)
{
    QList&lt;QGraphicsPathItem *&gt; list;
    list &lt;&lt; m_item1 &lt;&lt; m_item2 &lt;&lt; m_item3 &lt;&lt; m_item4
         &lt;&lt; m_item5 &lt;&lt; m_item6 &lt;&lt; m_item7 &lt;&lt; m_item8;

    for (QGraphicsPathItem *item : qAsConst(list)) {
        QPainterPath path = item-&gt;path();
        path.setFillRule(rule);
        item-&gt;setPath(path);
    }

    m_scene-&gt;update();
}

void Form::onOddEvenClicked()
{
    applyFillRule(Qt::OddEvenFill);
}

void Form::onWindingClicked()
{
    applyFillRule(Qt::WindingFill);
}

</code></pre>
</details>
